北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴冷，体感 -1℃，注意保暖，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is gloomy and cold, feels like -1℃. Stay warm and don't catch a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云，体感 14℃，风力 3级。出门添衣，小心着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like 14℃ with 3-level wind. Add clothes when out, watch out for chill.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 17℃，微风舒适，享受美好时光吧！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like 17℃, with a comfortable breeze. Enjoy your day!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴朗，体感 25℃，温暖宜人。多补充水分哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm, feels like 25℃. Remember to hydrate!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴好，体感 26℃，湿度较高。注意防晒补水哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny, feels like 26℃ with high humidity. Remember sunscreen and hydration.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感 20℃，微风送爽。心情也跟着放晴吧！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and feels like 20℃ with a gentle breeze. Let your mood brighten too!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 8℃，风大。多穿点，小心着凉哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels like 8℃ with strong wind. Bundle up to avoid catching a cold!
南京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 15℃。早晚温差大，注意适时添衣。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 15℃. Big temperature difference, dress accordingly.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴冷，体感 6℃。湿气重，穿暖和点，小心着凉。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is gloomy and cold, feels like 6℃. High humidity, dress warmly to avoid a chill.
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 2℃。气温较低，记得多添衣保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 2℃. Temperatures are low, remember to add clothes and stay warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 17℃，体感舒适。出门记得带把伞哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 17℃, comfortable. Remember to bring an umbrella when out.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨严寒，体感 -11℃。全副武装，注意防寒保暖哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is severely cold, feels like -11℃. Bundle up completely and stay warm!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗但体感 -7℃，风力 3级。户外注意防风保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels like -7℃ with 3-level wind. For outdoor activities, remember to stay warm and protected from wind.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 17℃。天气干燥，记得多补充水分。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and feels like 17℃. It's dry, so remember to hydrate.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴好，体感 25℃，暖意融融。享受阳光与海风吧。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and feels like 25℃, pleasantly warm. Enjoy the sun and sea breeze.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷，体感 -3℃，风力 5级。风大，注意防风保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is gloomy and cold, feels like -3℃ with 5-level wind. It's very windy, stay warm and protected!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴冷，体感 -11℃，风力 5级。风寒刺骨，务必多穿！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is gloomy and cold, feels like -11℃ with 5-level wind. The wind chill is biting, make sure to bundle up!
大连.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级
